alerts.title: Infrastructure alerts
alerts.description: An infrastructure alert tells Root when something in the platform fails, for example when the daily audit anchor could not be published.
alerts.rule: Choose where they are sent. At least one channel must stay on.
alerts.defaults: No configuration has been saved yet: the defaults apply (email and Telegram on) until you save.
alerts.channels.email.label: Email
alerts.channels.email.description: Each active Root receives it in her language.
alerts.channels.telegram.label: Telegram
alerts.conflict: Someone else changed these settings while you were editing. The current values were loaded; review them and save again.
telegram.title: Telegram channel
telegram.description: Alerts reach a Telegram chat through a bot. Create the bot with BotFather, then copy its token and the ID of the chat it should write to.
telegram.empty: No Telegram channel is configured yet. Until then, alerts are sent by email only.
telegram.details.name: Name
telegram.test.sent: The test message was sent. Check the Telegram chat.
telegram.test.CREDENTIALS_REJECTED: Telegram rejected the bot token. Replace it with a valid one.
telegram.test.CHAT_REJECTED: Telegram could not write to that chat. Check the chat ID and that the bot is a member of the chat.
telegram.test.RATE_LIMITED: Telegram asked to wait before receiving more messages. Try again in a few minutes.
telegram.test.UNAVAILABLE: Telegram could not be reached. Try again later.
telegram.form.name: Channel name
telegram.form.nameHelp: Only used to recognize it on this screen, for example “Infrastructure on-call”.
telegram.form.chatIdHelp: A whole number; groups and channels are negative. It is not the chat name or link.
telegram.form.botTokenHelp: Given by BotFather in the form 123456789:AbC… It is stored encrypted and never shown again.
telegram.create.title: Set up Telegram channel
telegram.create.description: Enter the bot and the chat that will receive infrastructure alerts.
telegram.edit.title: Edit Telegram channel
telegram.edit.description: Change the name or the chat. The bot token is changed separately.
telegram.token.title: Change bot token
telegram.token.description: The stored token cannot be viewed. Enter the new one to replace it.
telegram.archive.title: Archive “{{name}}”?
telegram.archive.description: Alerts will stop being sent through Telegram. To use it again you will have to set up a new channel.
